name: ocra-min
description: OAuth2 PKCE Demo with React Frontend and Node.js Backend

scripts.update:openlime: git submodule update --remote --recursive frontend/openlime && npm run build:openlime
scripts.update:three-presenter: git submodule update --remote --recursive frontend/three-presenter && npm run build:three-presenter
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:migrate:bare: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:migrate:compose: cd backend && DATABASE_URL='postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/oauth_demo?schema=public' DIRECT_URL='postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/oauth_demo?schema=public' npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && npx prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.test:annotation-creation: cd backend && npx vitest run src/test/annotation-creation.api.test.ts
scripts.test:annotation-deletion: vitest run --config vitest.unit.config.ts frontend/src/features/annotation-deletion frontend/src/stores/AnnotationStore.deletion.test.ts && cd backend && npx vitest run src/test/annotation-deletion.api.test.ts
scripts.project:inspect: docker compose exec backend npm run project:inspect --workspace backend --
